topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I found out today that Mr. Thompson, the quiet old man who lives next door, has been secretly living a life of luxury. It all came out at the community yard sale where he accidentally left his wallet open. Stacks of crisp bills, more than anyone should have on them. I kept my head down when he walked by, avoiding his kind eyes. It’s strange, isn’t it? Here I am, worrying about making ends meet, while he’s been quietly sitting on a fortune. I wonder what it is he does, or did, to have so much. The thought of it just makes me want to go home and check my bank account again.
